example.en: The meeting came to an abrupt end.
example.zh: 会议突然结束了。

mnemonic: ab-（离开）+ rupt（断裂）→ 突然断开

example.en: It is absurd to memorize without review.
example.zh: 只背不复习是荒唐的。

example.en: Spaced review accelerates memorization.
example.zh: 间隔复习能加速记忆。

mnemonic: ac- + celer（快速）+ ate → 使变快

example.en: The campus faces an acute shortage of tutors.
example.zh: 校园面临辅导员的严重短缺。

example.en: She adheres to her review schedule.
example.zh: 她坚持自己的复习计划。

mnemonic: ad- + here（粘）→ 粘住不放 → 坚持

example.en: The library is adjacent to the canteen.
example.zh: 图书馆紧邻食堂。

mnemonic: ad- + jac（躺）+ ent → 躺在旁边

example.en: The aggregate score decides the ranking.
example.zh: 总分决定排名。

mnemonic: ag- + greg（群体）+ ate → 聚成一群 → 合计

example.en: Exercise alleviates exam anxiety.
example.zh: 运动能缓解考试焦虑。

mnemonic: al- + lev（轻）+ iate → 使变轻

example.en: The survey is completely anonymous.
example.zh: 这份问卷完全匿名。

mnemonic: an-（无）+ onym（名字）+ ous → 无名的

example.en: She articulated her ideas clearly.
example.zh: 她清晰地表达了自己的想法。

mnemonic: articul（关节）+ ate → 关节分明 → 字字清楚

example.en: He asserted that the data was wrong.
example.zh: 他断言数据有误。

example.en: Review helps assimilate new words.
example.zh: 复习有助于吸收新单词。

mnemonic: as- + simil（相同）+ ate → 使相同 → 同化

example.en: Flashcards augment classroom learning.
example.zh: 抽认卡补充了课堂学习。

example.en: Read authentic English articles daily.
example.zh: 每天读真实的英语文章。

example.en: Early review averted a forgetting crisis.
example.zh: 及时复习避免了遗忘危机。

mnemonic: a- + vert（转）→ 转开 → 避免

example.en: The long passage bewildered the freshmen.
example.zh: 这篇长文让新生们不知所措。

example.en: Sharing answers is a breach of the rules.
example.zh: 分享答案是违规行为。

example.en: His review time coincides with lunch.
example.zh: 他的复习时间和午饭重合。

mnemonic: co- + in + cide（落下）→ 一起落下 → 同时发生

example.en: Students collaborate on the project.
example.zh: 学生们合作完成这个项目。

example.en: Curiosity compels her to read more.
example.zh: 好奇心驱使她读得更多。

example.en: He compiled a list of frequent words.
example.zh: 他汇编了一份高频词表。

mnemonic: com- + pile（堆）→ 堆到一起 → 汇编

example.en: Both sides reached a compromise.
example.zh: 双方达成了妥协。

mnemonic: com- + promise（承诺）→ 相互承诺 → 折中

example.en: He conceded that he had forgotten the word.
example.zh: 他承认自己忘了这个单词。

example.en: She contemplated changing her major.
example.zh: 她考虑过换专业。

example.en: The new policy is highly controversial.
example.zh: 这项新政策颇具争议。

example.en: Many countries have abolished the death penalty.
example.zh: 许多国家已经废除了死刑。

mnemonic: a（离开）+ bol（扔）+ ish → 废除

example.en: Stories of bravery abound in this small village.
example.zh: 这个小村庄里充斥着许多勇敢的故事。

mnemonic: a（在）+ bound（界限）→ 超界限→大量存在

example.en: The young singer won critical acclaim for her performance.
example.zh: 这位年轻歌手的表演赢得了评论界的高度赞誉。

mnemonic: ac（向）+ claim（喊）→ 向…欢呼→称赞

example.en: Dust can accumulate quickly if you don't clean.
example.zh: 如果不打扫，灰尘会很快堆积起来。

mnemonic: ac（向）+ cumul（堆）+ ate → 积累

example.en: The hospital is affiliated with a famous medical school.
example.zh: 这家医院附属于一所著名的医学院。

mnemonic: af（向）+ fili（子）+ ate → 收为附属

example.en: Smoking will only aggravate your cough.
example.zh: 吸烟只会加重你的咳嗽。

mnemonic: ag（加强）+ grav（重）+ ate → 加重

example.en: The report alleges that the company broke the law.
example.zh: 该报告声称这家公司违反了法律。

mnemonic: al（向）+ leg（派遣）+ e → 声称

example.en: Congress voted to amend the existing tax law.
example.zh: 国会投票修正了现有的税法。

example.en: He explained the idea by drawing an analogy with music.
example.zh: 他通过与音乐作类比来解释这个观点。

mnemonic: ana（类似）+ log（说）+ y → 类比

example.en: The lab bought new apparatus for the chemistry class.
example.zh: 实验室为化学课购置了新仪器。

mnemonic: ap（向）+ para（准备）+ tus → 器械

example.en: The manager gave a fair appraisal of her work.
example.zh: 经理对她的表现作了公正的评估。

mnemonic: ap（向）+ praise（价值）+ al → 评估

example.en: We watched the balloon slowly ascend into the sky.
example.zh: 我们看着气球缓缓升上天空。

mnemonic: a（向）+ scend（爬）→ 上升（对比 descend）

example.en: Her aspiration is to become a doctor in the future.
example.zh: 她的抱负是将来成为一名医生。

mnemonic: a（向）+ spir（呼吸）+ ation → 渴望

example.en: The region was granted greater autonomy last year.
example.zh: 该地区去年获得了更大的自治权。

mnemonic: auto（自己）+ nom（管理）+ y → 自治

example.en: Nothing grows in the barren desert soil.
example.zh: 贫瘠的沙漠土壤里什么都不长。

mnemonic: 对比 bear（结果）→ 不结果→贫瘠

example.en: He would never betray his best friend for money.
example.zh: 他绝不会为钱背叛挚友。

mnemonic: be+tray托盘：把信任端到敌人面前

example.en: The team drew up a blueprint for the new project.
example.zh: 团队为新项目起草了一份蓝图（方案）。

example.en: He made a terrible blunder in the final exam.
example.zh: 他在期末考试中犯了一个严重的错误。

mnemonic: bl（笨）+ under（下）→ 犯下大错

example.en: Many customers boycott products from that factory.
example.zh: 许多消费者抵制那家工厂的产品。

example.en: The brittle glass broke into pieces at once.
example.zh: 那块易碎的玻璃立刻碎成了几片。

example.en: The bureaucracy slowed down the approval process.
example.zh: 官僚机构拖慢了审批流程。

example.en: He suffers from chronic back pain.
example.zh: 他患有慢性背痛。

example.en: The teacher explained the rule with great clarity.
example.zh: 老师非常清晰地解释了这条规则。

example.en: His speech was clear and coherent.
example.zh: 他的演讲清晰且连贯。

example.en: The meeting will commence at nine o'clock.
example.zh: 会议将于九点开始。

example.en: Oil is an important commodity in global trade.
example.zh: 石油是全球贸易中的重要商品。

example.en: This printer is compatible with your laptop.
example.zh: 这台打印机与你的笔记本兼容。

example.en: The red tie complements his dark suit.
example.zh: 这条红领带与他深色西装很相配。

example.en: She is a conscientious worker who never cuts corners.
example.zh: 她是位认真负责的员工，从不偷工减料。

example.en: We reached a consensus after a long discussion.
example.zh: 经过长时间讨论，我们达成了共识。

example.en: The bright sign was conspicuous from far away.
example.zh: 那块鲜艳的招牌在远处就很显眼。

example.en: He looked at the liar with contempt.
example.zh: 他轻蔑地看着那个说谎者。

example.en: His statement contradicts the facts.
example.zh: 他的说法与事实相矛盾。

example.en: He is cynical about politicians' promises.
example.zh: 他对政客的承诺持怀疑态度。

example.en: The country faces a large budget deficit.
example.zh: 该国面临巨额预算赤字。

example.en: Plastic takes years to degrade in nature.
example.zh: 塑料在自然界中需要多年才能降解。

example.en: The group denounces violence of any kind.
example.zh: 该组织谴责任何形式的暴力。

example.en: She was designated as team leader.
example.zh: 她被指定为团队负责人。

example.en: His health began to deteriorate last winter.
example.zh: 去年冬天他的健康开始恶化。

example.en: She faced a dilemma between job and study.
example.zh: 她在工作和学业之间面临两难。

example.en: He is diligent in his study every day.
example.zh: 他每天学习都很勤奋。

example.en: She made an eloquent speech at the meeting.
example.zh: 她在会上作了雄辩的发言。

meanings: 以经验为依据的，实证的

example.en: The theory is based on empirical evidence.
example.zh: 该理论建立在实证证据之上。

example.en: We endeavor to finish the project on time.
example.zh: 我们努力按时完成项目。

example.en: The book enlightened me on the issue.
example.zh: 这本书让我对这个问题有所启发。

example.en: Reading can enrich our knowledge.
example.zh: 阅读能丰富我们的知识。

example.en: She is enthusiastic about the new plan.
example.zh: 她对新计划充满热情。

example.en: This word is equivalent to that in meaning.
example.zh: 这个词在意义上等同于那个词。

example.en: Soil erosion is a serious problem here.
example.zh: 水土流失在这里是严重问题。

example.en: She wore an exquisite diamond necklace.
example.zh: 她戴着一条精美的钻石项链。

example.en: He is extravagant with his money.
example.zh: 他在花钱上很奢侈。

example.en: Is this plan feasible in practice?
example.zh: 这个计划在实践上可行吗？

example.en: The bad weather frustrated our plan.
example.zh: 糟糕的天气挫败了我们的计划。

example.en: Experts confirmed that the painting was a genuine work by Van Gogh.
example.zh: 专家确认这幅画是梵高的真迹。

mnemonic: genu(出生)+ine——天生原装的，真正的

example.en: What a gorgeous sunset we saw!
example.zh: 我们看到了多么华丽的日落！

example.en: The company has a clear hierarchy.
example.zh: 这家公司有着清晰的等级制度。

example.en: The neighborhood is socially homogeneous.
example.zh: 这个社区在社会构成上很同质。

example.en: The hypothesis needs further testing.
example.zh: 这个假说需要进一步检验。

example.en: Different parties hold different ideologies.
example.zh: 不同政党持有不同的意识形态。

example.en: She immersed herself in her research.
example.zh: 她全心投入到研究中。

example.en: He is immune to criticism.
example.zh: 他对批评免疫（不受影响）。

example.en: Tax cuts act as an incentive to invest.
example.zh: 减税是对投资的激励。

example.en: Water is indispensable to life.
example.zh: 水对生命不可或缺。

example.en: The city needs better transport infrastructure.
example.zh: 这座城市需要更好的交通基础设施。

example.en: There is a risk inherent in the plan.
example.zh: 该计划存在固有的风险。

example.en: He took the initiative to solve the problem.
example.zh: 他主动着手解决这个问题。

example.en: He is a man of great integrity.
example.zh: 他是个极有正直品格的人。

example.en: The teacher intervened in the fight.
example.zh: 老师介入制止了那场打架。

example.en: The watch has an intricate mechanism.
example.zh: 这块表有着错综复杂的机械结构。

example.en: He has a legitimate reason to leave.
example.zh: 他有正当的理由离开。

example.en: I literally finished the book in one day.
example.zh: 我真的只用一天就看完了这本书。

example.en: The lens can magnify the tiny insect.
example.zh: 这个镜片能放大那只微小的昆虫。

example.en: He learned to manipulate the software to finish the task faster.
example.zh: 他学会了熟练操作这款软件，以更快完成任务。

mnemonic: mani(手)+pul(拉)+ate → 用手摆布 → 操纵

example.en: The teacher tried to mediate the quarrel between the two boys.
example.zh: 老师试图调解两个男孩之间的争吵。

mnemonic: medi(中间)+ate → 在中间 → 调解

example.en: She kept meticulous notes of every experiment she did.
example.zh: 她把自己做的每个实验都做了细致的记录。

mnemonic: meticul(害怕)+ous → 生怕出错 → 一丝不苟的

example.en: The area is notorious for its heavy traffic jams.
example.zh: 这个地区因严重的交通堵塞而臭名昭著。

mnemonic: not(知道)+orious → 大家都知道坏事 → 臭名昭著的

example.en: Parents should nurture their children with love and patience.
example.zh: 父母应当用爱与耐心养育孩子。

example.en: The flood nearly obliterated the small village from the map.
example.zh: 洪水几乎把这个小村庄从地图上抹去了。

mnemonic: ob(消去)+liter(文字)+ate → 抹去文字 → 抹去

example.en: The meaning of the poem is too obscure for me to grasp.
example.zh: 这首诗的含义太晦涩，我理解不了。

mnemonic: ob(在…上)+scure(覆盖) → 遮住的 → 晦涩的

example.en: It is a paradox that we sleep less but feel more tired.
example.zh: 我们睡得少却更累，这真是自相矛盾。

mnemonic: para(相反)+dox(观点) → 相反观点 → 悖论

example.en: A smell of coffee permeated the whole office in the morning.
example.zh: 早晨一股咖啡味弥漫了整个办公室。

mnemonic: per(贯穿)+me(通过)+ate → 渗透，弥漫

example.en: We need a pragmatic plan rather than a perfect one.
example.zh: 我们需要一个务实的方案，而不是完美的方案。

mnemonic: prag(做)+matic → 注重做的 → 务实的

example.en: The court ruling set a precedent for later cases.
example.zh: 这项法院判决为后来的案件树立了先例。

mnemonic: pre(前)+ced(走)+ent → 先前走过的 → 先例

example.en: The university gained prestige for its medical research.
example.zh: 这所大学因其医学研究而获得声望。

example.en: The book had a profound influence on my thinking.
example.zh: 这本书对我的思维产生了深远的影响。

mnemonic: pro(深)+found(底部) → 深的 → 深刻的

example.en: The town became prosperous after the new factory opened.
example.zh: 新工厂开业后，这个镇子变得繁荣了。

mnemonic: prosper(繁荣)+ous → 繁荣的，富裕的

example.en: The report came under close scrutiny by the public.
example.zh: 这份报告受到了公众的仔细审查。

example.en: Many experts are skeptical about this new theory.
example.zh: 许多专家对这套新理论持怀疑态度。

mnemonic: skept（怀疑）+ ical → 怀疑的；谐音死看透

example.en: Their applause was spontaneous and warm.
example.zh: 他们的掌声是自发的、热烈的。

mnemonic: spon（承诺）+ taneous → 自发自愿的

example.en: There is a subtle difference between the two words.
example.zh: 这两个词之间有微妙的区别。

mnemonic: sub（下）+ tle → 暗藏的、微妙的

example.en: Filling in the form was a tedious task.
example.zh: 填这张表是件冗长乏味的事。

mnemonic: ted（疲倦）+ ious → 令人疲倦的、乏味的

example.en: Don't waste time on such trivial matters.
example.zh: 别把时间浪费在如此琐碎的小事上。

mnemonic: tri（琐碎）+ ial → 琐碎的、不重要的

example.en: Bad habits can undermine your health over time.
example.zh: 坏习惯会随着时间的推移损害你的健康。

mnemonic: under（下）+ mine（挖）→ 从下面挖、暗中破坏

example.en: She is a versatile actress who sings and dances well.
example.zh: 她是一位多才多艺的演员，能歌善舞。

mnemonic: vers(转)+atile→能转多个方向→多才多艺的

example.en: Children are especially vulnerable to online scams.
example.zh: 儿童尤其容易遭受网络骗局伤害。
